what: O with one variable changed: one-seat.md step 2 asked for each brief to be written to ../briefs/<id>.md before dispatching, so the dispatch itself is three uniform lines and batching is trivial. Same tree (994b39c6), same jobs.md, same brief as O.
hypothesis: if runnable artifacts propagate where instructions do not, making the dispatch a lookup rather than an authoring act should produce batching
verdict: rejected, and the step was reverted
why_it_lost: writing the four briefs cost 77s with no agent running. Composing a prompt between dispatches (as O did) overlaps with agents already working, so moving it earlier turns overlapped time into serial time: 19s of stagger bought for 77s of dead air.
what_it_settled: across N, O and P the makespan equalled the slowest job plus how late that job was dispatched (69s, 23s, 4s) -- clip was third out of the door every time. The batching rule was chasing the wrong variable; step 2 now asks for the longest job first.
